pr_title: lib: updatehub: Fix getaddrinfo resource leak
pr_body:
Add missing freeaddrinfo to fix memory leak.

Fixes #26994.

Signed-off-by: Gerson Fernando Budke <gerson.budke@ossystems.com.br>

comments:
Hi @dleach02 thank you for point me that. I don't have access to report yet and with this tip I know what I need fix.
By the way, I discovered by other way #26720 and opened #27028.

The fix for this particular problem is simple and just needs a freeaddrinfo() in the scope of this routine if there was a successful getaddrinfo(). The rest of the issues you are bringing up in the other items are somewhat orthogonal to this and can be dealt with separately. I would just submit a simple PR to fix this particular coverity (and real resources leak) issue.

review_comments: Shouldn't you close the socket when returning false ? AFAIU you'll keep this socket open in a variable that is statically alloated
I don't think you need this extra function. `ctx.fds` is set only in `prepare_fds` that is not called in the error path.

This is not a new extra function. I moved it up on code because is an internal without prototype. Since we added a for loop based on nfds and proper initialize nfds we can call cleanup_connection. This method will report an error if close is accessed without a valid socket. I think it is better keep only one way to close and clean the socket in this case.
oh yeah, sorry. I thought I had seen this cleanup function memseting an arbitrary descriptor.
